objective: Prepare stateless Cloud Run persistence with Next.js standalone build target, Firestore-backed fleet registry state, and cloud object storage backend adapters (GCS and Backblaze B2) for ContentAddressedStore.

rulesConsidered: Container deployment on Cloud Run requires minimal standalone output without copying full node_modules.
Control plane state in serverless cloud environments must persist to durable cloud datastores (Firestore instabox_fleet_state).
Production environments must fail closed if required cloud persistence credentials are missing.
CAS storage must support streaming cloud object storage (GCS and Backblaze B2) to prevent unbounded local disk exhaustion.
Local CAS filesystem should act as a bounded cache with automated cache pruning.
No secrets, private keys, or tokens may be committed to repository history.

forensicFindings: Next.js build in apps/web previously generated standard Next.js server output which bundles unnecessary build assets rather than a standalone container target.
InstaBoxFleetRegistry relied exclusively on local JSON disk storage (data/factoryos_state/instabox_fleet_state.json), which would be lost upon container recycling in Cloud Run.
ContentAddressedStore only supported local POSIX disk storage, risking local disk exhaustion on ephemeral container disks without cloud replication.
changes: Added output: 'standalone' to apps/web/next.config.mjs to generate optimized container builds for Cloud Run.
Enhanced InstaBoxFleetRegistry with Firestore persistence adapter (collection 'instabox_fleet_state', doc 'current') with loadPersistedStateFromFirestore() and persistStateToFirestore().
Added InstaBoxPersistenceError typed error and enforced fail-closed validation in NODE_ENV === 'production' when Firestore credentials are missing.
Preserved local JSON persistence fallback for development and test environments.
Added CasCloudBackend interface to ContentAddressedStore along with GcsCasBackend (streaming upload via write stream) and B2CasBackend (native fetch Backblaze B2 adapter).
Implemented bounded local CAS cache management (pruneLocalCache) and on-demand cloud re-hydration (ensureLocalFile) to keep local storage bounded on Cloud Run.
Authored comprehensive unit test suite in apps/web/factoryos/tests/cloudrun-stateless-persistence.test.ts (8/8 passing, 100% mocked, zero live cloud calls).

security.notes: Zero credentials committed. All Firestore and cloud storage credentials are dynamically read from standard environment variables.
